full_name: Morwaread Mary Farbood | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Engineering & Computer Science William Bentinck-Smith Fellow New York University
bio: Morwaread Mary Farbood is an associate professor in the music technology program at New York University. Drawing from methodologies in the fields of music theory, cognitive psychology, and computer science, her research focuses primarily on the computational modeling of real-time aspects of music perception.
